Definition: Chilhijah, the name of eight Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hilkiah is the high priest who found the book of the law in the house of the Lord, and his name marks the turning point of Josiah's reign. In Kings he tells Shaphan that he has found the book, and in Chronicles he gives it to be read before the king, so that the whole nation hears what it had lost.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the finding of the book is the hinge of the whole story, because a nation that had lost God's word found it again. I hold that Hilkiah's discovery is still the pattern: revival begins when the book is opened.
